questions.text: Tell me about a project you owned from start to finish.
Describe a time you disagreed with a senior engineer about a design.
Tell me about a time you helped another team ship something.
Walk me through a production incident you led the response to.
Tell me about a decision you would make differently now.
How did you raise the quality bar on your team?
Explain a trade-off you made between speed and reliability.
probe_hints: Ask why not the simpler option

questions.text: How would you explain your system's design to a new engineer?
How would you size the demand for a new payment method?
Why do you want this role, and what scope do you want next?

curveball: Halfway through, say the budget was cut in half and ask how the plan changes.
